title: Readiness Estimator: Civilization Backup Protocols
definition: Estimates Civilization Backup Protocols readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Civilization Backup Protocols components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a protocol hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Civilization Backup Protocols Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Civilization Backup Protocols: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Civilization Backup Protocols — protocols backing up civilization itself.

Phase 1 — Prove (backup checklists): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (protocol logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (priority tiers): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (refresh cycles): protocol hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and heritage-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
